findings.label: iOS icon tint is dropped
findings.detail: The `typeof color === 'string'` guard in ListRow, ErrorState, and EmptyState is always false for PlatformColor tokens on iOS, so the chevron, error, and empty symbols render in the default system label color instead of their intended tertiaryLabel / statusFailed / secondaryLabel tint. Non-blocking: the fallback is sensible and matches the approved StatusBadge pattern. To tint them, AppIcon.color would need to accept ColorToken and pass it to tintColor — a follow-up for the AppIcon/typing layer, not task 4.

findings.label: Duplicate testID skeleton-bar
findings.detail: Both SkeletonRow bars share testID="skeleton-bar". Harmless for the current findAllByProps count assertions, but worth noting if a single bar is ever queried by id.
